Action 01.name: Smash Axe
Action 01.content: Delivers an attack with a potency of 160.

Action 02.name: Capture
Action 02.content:
Delivers an attack with a potency of 100.
Target cannot be incapacitated by this attack.
Additional Effect: Marks target with Interest Captured
Duration: 120s
Interest Captured Effect: Forges a pact with the targeted beast should you succeed in their subdual
Success is determined upon defeating targets under the effect of Interest Captured.
An entry in the Master's Bestiary will be added upon successful subdual, allowing the beast to be summoned as a familiar.
Success rate is inversely proportional to the target's HP at the time of execution. Furthermore, success rate increases if the target is a lower level than you.
Ineffective against targets whose level is higher than your own.

Action 03.name: First Battlehorn
Action 03.content:
Summons your [beast] to fight at your side.
During combat, recast timer cooldown will begin once your familiar has retreated. Retreat outside of combat will not affect recast timer.
Additional Effect: Grants One with Nature
Additional Effect: Resets Tempered Release recast timer
Additional Effect: Resets Borrow recast timer

Action 04.name: Gauge
Action 04.content:
Investigates a targeted beast's probability of Capture.
Can be executed while mounted, but only when grounded.

Combo Action: Smash Axe
Combo Potency: 500
Combo Bonus: Increases TP Gauge by 13

Action 06.name: Avalanche Axe
Action 06.content:
Delivers an attack with a potency of 400.
Potency increases up to 1,000 as TP nears maximum. All TP will be expended upon execution.
Minimum TP Gauge Cost: 100
Instinctual Affinity: Rampant
Additional Effect: Grants Rampant Heart
Duration: 7s
Instinctual skills may be executed sequentially to deal additional damage, which is determined by the skill that completes the combo.
Executing a Rampant skill while under the effect of Volant Heart will complete a Sunstrider intentional combo, dealing greater additional damage.
Instinctual skills do not share a recast timer with any other actions.

Lingering Vantage Potency: 1,500
Familiar retreats from combat upon execution.
Additional Effect: Increases Familiar TP Gauge by 24
Can only be executed while in combat.

Action 16.name: Beast Mode
Action 16.content:
Upon using Borrow, changes to an action dependent on Kinship.
Beast Kinship Effect: Action reduces physical vulnerability
Vile Kinship Effect: Action increases block rate
Cloud Kinship Effect: Action bolsters movement
Seed Kinship Effect: Action inflicts poison and weakening effects
Wave Kinship Effect: Action deals ranged magic damage to a single target
Scale Kinship Effect: Action absorbs magic damage
Soul Kinship Effect: Action delivers an attack that interrupts a single target
Ash Kinship Effect: Action removes a detrimental effect

Action 17.name: Borrow
Action 17.content:
Borrows aether from your summoned familiar to gain Kinship according to its classification.
Beastkin Familiar Effect: Grants Beast Kinship
Vilekin Familiar Effect: Grants Vile Kinship
Cloudkin Familiar Effect: Grants Cloud Kinship
Seedkin Familiar Effect: Grants Seed Kinship
Wavekin Familiar Effect: Grants Wave Kinship
Scalekin Familiar Effect: Grants Scale Kinship
Soulkin Familiar Effect: Grants Soul Kinship
Ashkin Familiar Effect: Grants Ash Kinship
Changes Beast Mode into an action according to your familiar's classification.
Duration: 90s
Expiration timer is halted while your familiar is summoned.
Additional Effect: Grants Lingering Vantage
Duration: 60s
Can only be executed while under the effect of One with Nature.
